title: Attack tokens in the enemy base: cap simultaneous attacks (bible section 14: max 2 dangerous attacks)
acceptance: BeginAttack is refused while the world's token limit is in use, and succeeds once a token is free
Tokens are released when an attack resolves, is interrupted, the enemy dies, is parked, or is destroyed
The limit is adjustable at runtime (the encounter director sets it)
description: Split out of T-0017. Enemies start their own attacks, so the director cannot enforce the 2-attack cap without a gate in AEnemyBase::BeginAttack.
